title: Calvin Klein Women's Square Silver-Tone Watch - Pre-owned
descriptionText: The Calvin Klein CK women's watch features a sleek square silver-tone case with a stylish purple band, making it a fashionable accessory for any woman's wrist. This wristwatch is part of the Swatch Lady collection, showcasing the brand's signature elegance and sophistication. Ideal for everyday wear or special occasions, this Calvin Klein watch combines functionality with a touch of luxury, making it a must-have for any fashion-forward woman.
